disk_review: The chosen fixture parent is a new private mkdtemp directory on the larger currently observed free volume among RUNNER_TEMP and Python tempfile roots; no existing fixture is adopted or unrelated file removed.

The foundation admission counts external originals, retained originals, separate catalog and journal estimates, manifest, chosen search spool, and free reserve. Largest-tier preflight additionally counts archive and verifier/restore staging before generation.

The backup adapter remeasures the live profile and actual fixture/temp free capacity and physical/cgroup availability, derives a typed external BackupBudget before archive creation, and fails NOT_RUN/nonzero if unavailable.

The external originals and live profile persist through the entire roundtrip. Backup, verify, restore execute sequentially; verifier TemporaryDirectory is closed before restore; fresh restore publication uses same-volume hard links to staging, which are removed before successful return.

The catalog measurement explicitly says application_profile includes retained originals and SQLite and categories overlap; the report does not sum those categories. Backup final whole-tree inventory is taken after all oracles and before report write.
Logical tree bytes are measured; allocation bytes use st_blocks where available and otherwise remain NOT_MEASURED. No continuous disk-peak claim is made.
memory_review: Every actual import worker records its own lifetime peak through the existing owned runner bootstrap; the parent reads this only after real runner return.
Coordinator getrusage or PeakWorkingSetSize is separate from individual worker peaks. The maximum of worker peaks is not added to the coordinator maximum.
simultaneous_family_peak remains NOT_MEASURED; no aggregate family peak is inferred.
SearchResources memory is a working source-window allowance, not an OS memory cap; 1GiB admits 33,554,432 raw characters while result count remains at most100.
Backup policy memory bounds manifest/metadata decoders and is checked against current availability; it is not an enforced RSS quota.
acceptance: All12 tiers require exact source counts, actual exit73 after durable commit and owned-family return, same saved queue resume, complete catalog/source/hash traversal, all50 anchors, quotations, Unicode, scope/federation and cold/reopen full-rank checks.
Exactly four largest jobs require BACKUP_RESTORE_VERIFIED, complete raw/catalog/source equality, old-attempt revocation/passive scan review, restored verified copy and foreign-scope refusal.
Every phase and before/after exact commit, package, origins and three script identities is required; failed/skipped/NOT_RUN mandatory phases cannot yield PASS.
